scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Hoo! Hah! Hoo! Hah!
Let me take you away to
a distant spiritual place,
a land of exotic mystery,
my hometown Ayothaya!
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
呼！哈！呼！哈！
让我带你去往一个
遥远的神圣之地，
一个充满异域神秘感的土地，
我的家乡哎哟泰雅！

scripts.text: About Ayothaya.
scripts.translation: 关于哎哟泰雅

scripts.text: Go to Ayothaya.
scripts.translation: 前往哎哟泰雅

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
We Ayothayans are a pious people who value peace and sincerity. We endeavor to lead simple, yet noble, lives in harmony with nature.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
我们哎哟泰雅人是虔诚的人民，重视和平与真诚。我们努力过着简单而高尚的生活，并与自然和谐共处。

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Our traditional cuisine is world famous. It's no surprise when we serve dishes like Tom Yum Goong, made of Shrimp, Lemon and Chillies, which has a tantalizing aroma and flavor beyond imagining.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
我们的传统美食闻名世界。当我们端出像泰式BBQ这样由虾、柠檬和辣椒制成的菜肴时，一点也不奇怪，它拥有难以想象的诱人香气和风味。

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
For those who crave adventure, there is an age old story about the Sa-mhing Tiger, an evil creature that haunts our temple ruins.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
对于那些渴望冒险的人来说，有一个关于萨明虎的古老传说，那是一个徘徊在我们寺庙废墟中的邪恶生物。

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Hoo! Hahh! Hoo! Hahh!
No man alive can resist the
call of this beautiful land.
Midgardians are
always welcome!
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
呼！哈！呼！哈！
活着的任何人都无法抗拒
这片美丽土地的召唤。
米德加尔特人
永远受到欢迎！

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Ah, you must pay 10,000 Zeny
if you wish to visit Ayothaya.
If you're ready, we can leave
right now~
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
啊，如果你想前往哎哟泰雅，
必须支付10,000 泽尼。
如果你准备好了，我们现在
就可以出发~

scripts.text: I'm ready, let's go!
scripts.translation: 我准备好了，出发吧！

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Hoo! Hah! Hoo! Hah!
Let us be off! Back to my
beautiful Ayothaya!
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
呼！哈！呼！哈！
我们出发吧！回到我
美丽的哎哟泰雅！

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
I am sorry, but you do not have the 10,000 Zeny to travel to Ayothaya. Such a price is nothing compared to the experiences that await you!
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
很抱歉，你没有足够的10,000 泽尼来前往哎哟泰雅。与等待着你的体验相比，这点费用根本不算什么！

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Have you ever dreamed
of a beautiful place filled
with spiritual serenity? You
must have been dreaming
of Ayothaya, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
你是否曾梦想过
一个充满神圣宁静的
美丽之地？我的朋友，你
一定梦见过哎哟泰雅。

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Hoo! Hah! Hmm! Hah!
So, how did you like Ayothaya? Did you get a chance to try Tom Yum Goong? When you're ready, I shall take you back home.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
呼！哈！嗯！哈！
那么，你觉得哎哟泰雅怎么样？有机会尝尝泰式BBQ吗？当你准备好时，我会带你回家的。

scripts.text: Go back to Alberta.
scripts.translation: 回到艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
You will be welcome to come back whenever you please. I hope that we will see each other again sometime soon. Thank you~
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
欢迎你随时回来。我希望我们很快能再次相见。谢谢~

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Ah yes. I understand that it is difficult to take leave of such a beautiful place. Do not worry
and take your time.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
啊，是的。我明白要离开这样一个美丽的地方是很困难的。别担心，慢慢来。

scripts.text:
[Thang]
There's an ancient,
dreadful building in
Ayothaya that no one
here dares approach...
scripts.translation:
[唐]
在哎哟泰雅有一座古老而
可怕的建筑，这里
没有人敢靠近……

scripts.text:
[Thang]
In the past, a few curious people went inside, despite the horror stories, and never returned. What on earth could be going on inside of that place?
scripts.translation:
[唐]
过去，尽管有那些恐怖的故事，还是有一些好奇的人进入了里面，但再也没有回来。那个地方里到底发生了什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Thang]
However, if you want to prove your courage to others, confronting the danger inside might be a worthy challenge for an adventurer...
I think.
scripts.translation:
[唐]
不过，如果你想向他人证明你的勇气，面对其中的危险或许是对冒险者来说值得挑战的事……
我想。

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Hello!
I don't think
we've met before.
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
你好！
我想我们之前
还没见过面。

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
You must be
from Midgard.
After all, I know every single person living in this village.
Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
你一定是
来自米德加尔特。
毕竟，这个村子里住着的每一个人我都认识。
嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Hmm...
May I ask about the land you
come from? I'm curious about
a lot of things in the outside world.
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
嗯……
可以问问你来自
什么样的土地吗？我对外界的
很多事情都很好奇。

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
You know, like the dresses and jewelry that ladies wear in other countries, whether or not the men are good looking, what kind of songs you have, what kind of girls that guys over there like...
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
你知道的，比如其他国家的女士们穿什么样的裙子和首饰，那里的男人帅不帅，有什么样的歌曲，那里的男孩子喜欢什么样的女孩子……

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Okay~!
Take care and
enjoy your travels!
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
好啦~！
请多保重，
祝你旅途愉快！

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
When you go East from this
village, you will arrive at the ruins of an old shrine. It is now
a nest full of fearsome monsters.
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
如果你从这个村子向东走，就会到达一座古老神庙的遗迹。那里现在
是凶猛怪物的巢穴。

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
If you plan to venture through these ruins, you better prepare
as much as you can!
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
如果你打算冒险进入这些遗迹，最好尽可能
做好充分的准备！

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Ah...
I wonder where
my Black Knight is~
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
啊……
不知道我的
黑骑士在哪里呢~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't you mean...
Knight in shining armor
riding a white horse?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你指的不是……
骑着白马、身披
闪亮铠甲的骑士吗？

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Hmm...?
Oh, well...
I'll take them both!
Hee hee~!
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
嗯……？
噢，好吧……
这两个我都想要！
嘻嘻~！

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Mmm...?
What's up?
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
嗯……？
怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Ummm.
Hmmmmm...
Ummmmm...?

[Villager]
You must be
an outsider.
Yes. Yes, indeed.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
你一定是
外地人。
没错，确实如此。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Did you just ask
where am I going?
Why, to the Fishing Spot
just ahead. That's what
we old men do: fish.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
你刚才是在问
我要去哪里吗？
噢，去前面的钓鱼场。这就是
我们这些老头子干的事：钓鱼。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Hmmm...
Would you like to hear
something interesting? I've heard that someone found a ring inside
a fish he caught in the
Fishing Spot.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
嗯……
想听点
有趣的事吗？我听说有人在钓鱼场
钓到的鱼肚子里
发现了一枚戒指。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Supposedly, there are lots of stories about people finding valuables inside of the fish they've been catching there.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
据说，有很多关于人们在钓鱼场钓到的鱼里
发现贵重物品的故事。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
If you're lucky enough,
you might even become
a millionaire.
Heh heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[村民]
如果你足够幸运，
甚至可能变成
百万富翁。
嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Villager]
...!?
Ah, I came into the fish market! ^666666*Sigh*^000000 It seems I went the wrong way. The Fishing Spot is on the opposite side of this village.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
……！？
啊，我进错鱼市了！ ^666666*唉*^000000 看来我走错路了。钓鱼场在村子的另一边。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Since I'm here, it wouldn't be
a bad idea to look around. All of the seafood in this market is fresh and tasty. You'll regret it if you don't try some of this seafood
at least once.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
既然都来了，四处逛逛也不错。这个市场里的海鲜都非常新鲜美味。要是没尝过一次这里的海鲜，你一定会后悔的。

scripts.text:
[Kwan]
Phew, isn't it
soooo hot today?
scripts.translation:
[关]
呼，今天是不是超级热呀？

scripts.text:
[Kwan]
You must be
from Midgard, huh?
I've seen a lot of tourists
coming from there recently.
scripts.translation:
[关]
你一定是来自米德加尔特吧？
我最近看到很多从那里来的游客。

scripts.text:
[Kwan]
You'd better be really careful if you travel outside of the village. Whatever you do, don't go into
the ruins of an old shrine
in the forest.
scripts.translation:
[关]
如果你要离开村子，最好一定要小心。无论做什么，千万不要进入森林里那座古老神庙的遗迹。

scripts.text:
[Kwan]
That place is far too
dangerous to visit. Still, I hear that if you had some kind of amulet, you could go there with
a little less worry...
scripts.translation:
[关]
那个地方太危险了，不适合前往。不过，我听说如果你身上带着某种护身符，去那里时会稍微少一些顾虑……

scripts.text:
[Kwan]
Well, anyway, it's still a really good idea to stay away from that place. I hope you enjoy visiting Ayothaya, and that you keep safe~
scripts.translation:
[关]
总之，远离那个地方还是明智的选择。希望你在哎哟泰雅玩得开心，并且平安无事~

scripts.text:
[Detzi]
In Ayothaya, we have our own traditional martial arts. We, the young men of the village, practice our traditional martial arts in order to become strong.
scripts.translation:
[德齐]
在哎哟泰雅，我们有自己的传统武术。我们这些村里的年轻人通过练习传统武术来变得强大。

scripts.text:
[Detzi]
Why don't you learn our martial arts? I guarantee that it will help you greatly in your travels.
scripts.translation:
[德齐]
你要不要学学我们的武术？我保证这会对你的旅程大有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Eik]
Hey...
You look pretty strong
You wanna challenge
me to a match?
scripts.translation:
[艾克]
嘿……
你看起来挺强的嘛。
想跟我切磋一下吗？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text: Nah~
scripts.translation: 不了~

scripts.text:
[Eik]
Ow ow ow!
I was just
kidding, man!
scripts.translation:
[艾克]
哎哟哟哟！
我只是开个玩笑啦！

scripts.text:
[Eik]
I'm not so rude as to pick fights with strangers for no reason!
scripts.translation:
[艾克]
我可没那么没礼貌，会无缘无故找陌生人打架！

scripts.text:
[Eik]
Real power is developed after having thousands of matches with other people. So, don't be afraid of fighting, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾克]
真正的力量是在与他人进行成千上万次战斗后磨练出来的。所以，不要害怕战斗，好吗？
